articles.summary: Insteel Industries Inc. (NYSE: IIIN) today announced that its board of directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.03 per share and a special cash dividend of $1.00 per share of common stock payable on December 12, 2025, to shareholders of record as of November 28, 2025. We are pleased to announce a $1.00 per share special dividend, continuing our track record of returning capital to shareholders.
